justifications.fit: The node is small by the contract (12 changed lines, one landing line, a fragment, no figure) and follows the delta idiom - a focused five-file gate measured at base and head with the failure-id set compared rather than absolute green; one dock for the base-arm header shape differing from the head arm's, which asks a reader to infer which revision the base log measured from its first line alone.
